### Take an interactive tour

Explore Splunk Platform features and workflows in this step-by-step guide.

How it works

The Splunk platform enables end-to-end visibility from edge to cloud

 ![service-monitoring-and-insights-dashboard-featured](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/screenshots/products/enterprise/es-search-your-data.png)

### **Search your data**

Explore data of any type and value — no matter where it lives in your data ecosystem.

### Analyze your data

Drive business resilience by monitoring, alerting, and reporting on your operations.  

 

 ![the-power-of-splunk-wherever-you-are](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/screenshots/software/the-power-of-splunk-wherever-you-are.jpg)

### Visualize your data

Create custom dashboards and data visualizations to unlock insights from anywhere — in your operations center, on the desktop, in the field, and on the go.

 ![enterprise-turn-data-into-doing](/content/dam/splunk2/images/screenshots/conf19/enterprise/enterprise-turn-data-into-doing.jpg)

### Act on your data

Use data from anywhere across your organization so you can make meaningful decisions fast.

## Features

## Access your data from anywhere

Leverage the platform from anywhere — whether you’re on-premises, at home, in your data center, or a combination of them all with a unified hybrid experience.

![Machine learning and AI](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/color-black/deep-learning.svg) ![Machine learning and AI](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/color-black/deep-learning.svg)

### Machine learning and AI

Predict and prevent, don’t just react. Improve security and business outcomes by bringing machine-level intelligence to your data.

![Data streaming](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/color-black/streamingdata.svg) ![Data streaming](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/color-black/streamingdata.svg)

### Data streaming

Collect, process, and distribute data to Splunk and other destinations in milliseconds with real-time stream processing.

![Scalable index](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/color-black/scalable.svg) ![Scalable index](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/color-black/scalable.svg)

### Scalable index

Collect and ingest data from thousands of sources and counting, all at terabyte scale.

![Collaborative tools](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/color-black/ease-of-doing-business.svg) ![Collaborative tools](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/color-black/ease-of-doing-business.svg)

### Collaborative tools

Interact and collaborate from anywhere with mobile, TV, and augmented reality capabilities.

![Analytics workspace](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/color-black/splunk-user-behavior-analytics.svg) ![Analytics workspace](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/color-black/splunk-user-behavior-analytics.svg)

### Analytics workspace

React instantly with visualization. Convert logs into metrics, boost search and monitoring performance, and streamline alerting functions.

![Powerful dashboards](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/color-black/splunk-dashboard-examples.svg) ![Powerful dashboards](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/icon-library/color-black/splunk-dashboard-examples.svg)

### Powerful dashboards

Easily communicate even your most complex data stories using our intuitive dashboard-building experience.

Powered by Splunk AI

Splunk AI capabilities unlock more informed insights, and make human decision-making and threat response faster. Use our free machine learning apps — Splunk AI Assistant, Anomaly Detection Assistant, Deep Learning and Data Science App and the AI Toolkit. Plus, enjoy machine learning embedded throughout our products, including Splunk IT Service Intelligence (ITSI) to Splunk User Behavior Analytics (UBA) and many more.

![generic-hero-promo-card-desktop-bar-chart](/content/dam/splunk2/en_us/images/resources/product-and-solutions-resources/security/take-your-siem-to-the-cloud/generic-hero-promo-card-desktop-bar-chart.jpg)
